title: Krull dimension of a finite type algebra over a field is preserved by field extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $K/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] (a field $K$ with a ring homomorphism $k\to K$), and $S$ a finite type $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Let $K\otimes_kS$ be the tensor product, a $K$-algebra. Then the Krull dimensions [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] of the topological spaces $\operatorname{Spec}S$ and $\operatorname{Spec}(K\otimes_kS)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] are equal: $\dim\operatorname{Spec}(K\otimes_kS)=\dim\operatorname{Spec}S$ in $\{-\infty,0,1,2,\ldots,\infty\}$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00P3 (lemma-dimension-preserved-field-extension, algebra.tex line 28290), where $\dim(S)$ is the Krull dimension of the ring $S$, i.e. of $\operatorname{Spec}S$; tag verified in stacks-project/tags/tags (00P3,algebra-lemma-dimension-preserved-field-extension)

proof.text: The tensor swap S_K = S ⊗_k K ≅ K ⊗_k S induces a homeomorphism of prime spectra. By Mathlib IsHomeomorph.topologicalKrullDim_eq, their global topological Krull dimensions agree. It therefore suffices to prove dim Spec(S_K) = dim Spec(S).

The field K is a nontrivial free k-module, hence faithfully flat. By [lem-weil-pbc-field-extension-base-change-faithfully-flat], S_K is faithfully flat over S for its left-factor algebra structure. By [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-surjective-spectrum], contraction along S → S_K is surjective on prime spectra. Mathlib instances and PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat give these facts directly.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-dimension-supremum-local-dimensions] to Spec(S_K) and Spec(S). For every prime q_K of S_K, [lem-weil-pbc-dimension-at-point-field-extension] identifies its local dimension with the local dimension of its contraction. Replace each summand in the first supremum by this equal local dimension using iSup_congr. Surjectivity of contraction identifies the resulting supremum with the supremum over all points of Spec(S), by Function.Surjective.iSup_comp. This proves equality, also for the zero algebra because the empty supremum is bottom.
